title: Applications on Palmframe
description: Every palmy application, whether it builds, whether it works on the bare system, what it needs at runtime, and which are installed by default. Read from distro/apps/apps.tsv.
hast: Every palmy application builds for Palmframe. Whether it is useful there depends on what it needs at runtime, and Palmframe ships very little beyond the base system: no ffmpeg, PipeWire, NetworkManager, BlueZ, OpenSSL or ollama.
. 20 are installed by default; the rest are not packaged, or are in the repository for

files beside them. The status column is what the applications side recorded after running each program in a minimal root, not a promise. The toolkit-side description of each application, with screenshots, is on
Usable on a fresh Palmframe install with nothing added.

bsdtar built from source (libarchive 3.8.10, no libxml2/OpenSSL). QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py): archive --selftest 87 checks 0 failures; bsdtar round-trips tar.zst and zip; the app lists a zip

ffmpeg built from source, PipeWire host-copied. QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py): audio --selftest 111/0; the app decodes and plays a WAV through pw-cat and QEMU's HDA output captured it (peak 1258)
verified: renders and evaluates typed input in the minimal chroot, with and without libxkbcommon
local store under ~/.local/share; date +%z is busybox-compatible
the local relay chat talks to; a plain TCP server, no UI

wl-clipboard host-copied, in palmframe-runtime. QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py): wl-copy | wl-paste round-trips through the wm; the app recorded the copied entry; clipboard --selftest 117/0
word processor works with no deps; the prose-style panel shells out to vale
verified: typing with built-in US layout and with libxkbcommon. Redraws continuously while a caret is shown (thousands of commits/4 s against an unthrottled compositor)
wl-copy is shipped in palmframe-runtime (the emoji recipe does not depend on it yet); the copy action itself not exercised in QEMU
browsing, rename, trash work with no deps; 'copy path' has wl-copy now. 'Open terminal here' runs foot (should be term), 'open' runs xdg-open (not shipped)
session component: needs the wm (layer-shell) and palm-login; exits 1 against a compositor without layer-shell (verified)
wlr-layer-shell from the wm; .desktop files in /usr/share/applications; optional wl-copy, xdg-open
needs .desktop entries to list anything (distro/apps/desktop/ provides them); its terminal list knows foot/alacritty/kitty, not term
offline by design: no network code, renders a generated city
PipeWire + WirePlumber + pipewire-pulse. QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py): mixer --selftest 188/0; the app shows 'HDA Intel Analog Stereo' output and input from pactl/wpctl
verified. First-run welcome note fails when ~/.local is missing (store.odin uses make_directory, not make_directory_all); create ~/.local/share in the skeleton home
demo of the kit file picker; not for the default install
spreadsheet works; copying a range out uses wl-copy, now shipped
demo storefront/feed generator, no external tools
Software: discover, search, install, remove and update packages; changes go through palmd for group wheel. Verified in QEMU (distro/notes/store.md)
verified in the minimal chroot (host /proc bound in). User column shows uid? without /etc/passwd entries
verified: runs busybox sh and takes typed input in the minimal chroot
file-based issue tracker; mostly a CLI
ffmpeg (from source) + pw-cat. QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py): video --selftest 248/0; the app plays an H.264/AAC MP4 made by the guest's own ffmpeg
the session; bare-metal backend owned and verified by the wm agent, not here
Runs, but a named part of it needs something Palmframe does not ship.

package ai depends on ollama (host-copied, optional, 66 MB). In QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py) with --ollama: ollama serve + pull qwen3:0.6b + run answered; ai --selftest 181/0 and the UI comes up, but it still showed 'ollama is not answering' 6 s after the server came up (not followed further)
bluetoothctl, rfkill (packages bluez, rfkill; dbus; kernel CONFIG_BT)

BlueZ host-copied, bluetoothd a palm-init service on dbus, rfkill from util-linux. The app runs and reads bluetoothctl ('No adapter found'). The stock kernel has no CONFIG_BT, so bluetoothd exits; with distro/recipes/runtime/kernel.config it registers org.bluez. No controller in QEMU: pairing never exercised. bluetooth --selftest hangs past 120 s
links libopus.so.0 (package opus); ffmpeg, pw-play, pw-record, wpctl, v4l2-ctl

starts now (libopus 1.6.1 from source); call --selftest 345/0 in QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py); PipeWire and ffmpeg (libx264) present. No camera tool (v4l2-ctl) and no call between two machines tested
works against the bundled chat-server (apps/chat/server, built as chat-server); without it shows reconnecting
copying works now (wl-copy shipped); picking from the screen still needs grim+hyprctl
opens on built-in fixtures (QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py): mail --selftest 653/0, UI shown); mailcore now starts with OpenSSL, but no real IMAP/SMTP account was tried
links libssl.so.3, libcrypto.so.3, libz, libbrotli*, libzstd

starts: OpenSSL, zlib, brotli, zstd shipped (OpenSSL verified a real TLS 1.3 server with the shipped CA bundle in QEMU (distro/recipes/runtime/test-runtime.py)). mailcore --selftest --no-e2e: 556 passed, 2 failed, both on a home directory of /root under the harness (see distro/notes/runtime.md); e2e needs its test server
links libssl.so.3 et al; Mistral API over HTTPS; pdftoppm/pdfinfo/pdftotext

starts (OpenSSL shipped). Needs a Mistral API key and poppler (pdftoppm/pdfinfo/pdftotext, not shipped). ocr --selftest 129/149: the failures are the conversion path, writing under /root in the harness
the application command dispatcher (palm schema / palm notes ...). Renamed: /usr/bin/palm is the package manager
reads /sys/class/power_supply directly; session actions are stubbed in the app
the prose engine CLI; core checks need nothing
EPUB/text read natively; PDF and DjVu need poppler/djvulibre

vault --selftest 4678/0 and wl-copy/wl-paste are shipped, but the GUI launched in the QEMU harness exited with 'could not create /root/.local/share/palmy-vault' (HOME was /home/palm in the same shell; unexplained)
ffmpeg, ffprobe, pw-cat; media under the dev tree

runs; videoedit --selftest 337/1: the one failure is the 'subtitles' filter (ffmpeg is built without libass). Export uses libx264 (built in). MEDIA_DIR and the default output path are /home/alex paths
Builds, but needs a program or service Palmframe does not ship.
ffmpeg/ffprobe now shipped; still needs whisper-cli (whisper.cpp) and ffplay (ffmpeg is built without SDL)
ollama is packaged now; the bot also needs chat-server, which is not packaged

talks only to NetworkManager (nmcli), which is not shipped. Wi-Fi is iwd now (verified end to end over mac80211_hwsim with the runtime kernel config); the app needs an iwd backend (distro/notes/runtime.md)
Arch-specific declarative layer over pacman; meaningless on Palmframe (palm replaces it)
capture is entirely grim/slurp; needs screencopy in the wm as well
